name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2788: A parallel sweep found four more resolvers whose blanket except-arm handed back his live directory when isolation had been asked for, the worst binding the console log which is appended to on every line and truncated at 2MB. The three blanket arms were narrowed to the ImportError-only template the repo had already blessed, the verbatim copy now delegates, and the gate is a census that parses every module rather than a list of four.
